g.text: MODEL PROJECTION; no N>1 resident-service reuse or break-even measured. Every cycle repeats its own fixed cache/pool preparation.
First two panels exclude common initialization and final cleanup; third includes the Kimi controller envelope and mandated observations.
Dashed curves charge the historical qjhs002 conversion/controller envelope (678.13 s, including validation/exit/release), not pure conversion; later asset localization is excluded.
Kimi: 8 complete blocks; GLM: 6. GLM preparation may include preceding-pool unload. No uncertainty interval for this hypothetical trajectory is estimated.
